#Load libraries
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
```
#Sqt Mal compare
##Load data
```{r}
# sqrt
cp_rep1 <- read.csv("../Output/rep1/_Global fitting Mahalanobis - tcplResult.csv")
cp_rep1$rep <- "rep1"
cp_rep1$is_sqrt <- TRUE

cp_rep2 <- read.csv("../Output/rep2/_Global fitting Mahalanobis - tcplResult.csv")
cp_rep2$rep <- "rep2"
cp_rep2$is_sqrt <- TRUE

cp_rep3 <- read.csv("../Output/rep3/_Global fitting Mahalanobis - tcplResult.csv")
cp_rep3$rep <- "rep3"
cp_rep3$is_sqrt <- TRUE

cp_rep4 <- read.csv("../Output/rep4/_Global fitting Mahalanobis - tcplResult.csv")
cp_rep4$rep <- "rep4"
cp_rep4$is_sqrt <- TRUE


# No sqrt
cp_rep1_nosqrt <- read.csv("../Output/rep1/_Global fitting Mahalanobis - tcplResult_nosqrt.csv")
cp_rep1_nosqrt$rep <- "rep1"
cp_rep1_nosqrt$is_sqrt <- FALSE

cp_rep2_nosqrt <- read.csv("../Output/rep2/_Global fitting Mahalanobis - tcplResult_nosqrt.csv")
cp_rep2_nosqrt$rep <- "rep2"
cp_rep2_nosqrt$is_sqrt <- FALSE

cp_rep3_nosqrt <- read.csv("../Output/rep3/_Global fitting Mahalanobis - tcplResult_nosqrt.csv")
cp_rep3_nosqrt$rep <- "rep3"
cp_rep3_nosqrt$is_sqrt <- FALSE

cp_rep4_nosqrt <- read.csv("../Output/rep4/_Global fitting Mahalanobis - tcplResult_nosqrt.csv")
cp_rep4_nosqrt$rep <- "rep4"
cp_rep4_nosqrt$is_sqrt <- FALSE


# Combine all
cp <- rbind(
  cp_rep1, cp_rep2, cp_rep3, cp_rep4,
  cp_rep1_nosqrt, 
  cp_rep2_nosqrt,
  cp_rep3_nosqrt, 
  cp_rep4_nosqrt
)
```

##Mutate and plotr
```{r}
cp <- cp %>%
  dplyr::select(any_of(c("bmd", "name", "bmdl", "bmdu", "exp_name", "is_sqrt"))) %>%
  mutate(source = "CP") %>%
  rename(exp = exp_name) %>%
  mutate(
    name = ifelse(name == "Taxol (Paclitaxel)", "Taxol", name),
    name = ifelse(name == "Berberine Chloride", "Berberine chloride", name)
  )

shape_list <- c("rep1" =16, "rep2" =17, "rep3" =18, "rep4" =1)
plot <- ggplot(cp, aes(x = bmd, y = name, colour = is_sqrt, shape = exp)) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(xmin = bmdl, xmax = bmdu), width = 0.2) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  scale_shape_manual(name = "exp", values = shape_list) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 13, margin = margin(t = 15)),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 13),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10, colour = "black"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6, colour = "black", margin = margin(r = 5)),
    strip.text.x = element_text(size = 9, face = "bold"),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = NA),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 1)
  )

plot
ggsave("../Output/sqrt_bmd_results.png", plot, width = 20, height = 60,units = "cm")
```

##Load data
```{r}

cp_rep4 <- read.csv("../Output/rep4/Mal_sqrt/_Global fitting Mahalanobis - tcplResult.csv")
```
